floor.title: 🛡️ Intelligent floor price defence
floor.mechanism: When the market price approaches the floor price, the protocol will automatically activate defence mechanisms, using accumulated POL (Protocol Owned Liquidity) for support. This is not a rigid payout; it uses game theory to make shorting costs infinitely high.
floor.anti_gaming: Note: To prevent arbitrage attacks, specific trigger thresholds and defence strengths are dynamically adjusted and the exact values will not be disclosed.

lockup.title: Strategic Lock-up
lockup.desc: In a market rife with 'mouse warehouses' and 'hidden chips', we have chosen the hardest but most honest path. We deeply understand that only by completely eliminating user fears of 'team dumps' can we build true trust.
lockup.benefit: This is not just about lock-up rules; it’s our 'anti-harvest declaration'. Through this somewhat stringent self-restraint, we ensure that no one—whether founders or large holders—can betray the community in the early stages.
items: Completely transparent, no hiding: We have no hidden wallets or undisclosed early circulating supply. All chip distributions are publicly available on-chain, subject to community oversight.

Team commitment, long-term support: The core team's release period lasts up to 48 months (4 years). In the crypto world, 4 years is a long cycle. This proves that we are not here to make quick money, but are determined to experience the bull and bear markets together with the community and build long-term value.

Investor Consensus: Our early investors deeply identify with the 'sharing and gifting' culture of Red Packets and voluntarily sign a 36-month linear release agreement. This means that in the early stages of the project, no party (including investors) has enough chips to impact the market.

paragraphs: Moonpacket is a crypto Red Packet and marketing tool designed specifically for Telegram communities. Whether for community operations, event promotions, or inviting new users, moonpacket can help you accomplish it easily.

To encourage users to continue using the platform and establish long-term relationships, we launched the $MOONINI community incentive token. Every active behaviour on the platform, including sending red packets, completing tasks, and inviting friends, can earn corresponding $MOONINI rewards.

For general users, $MOONINI is an additional reward for using moonpacket; the more you use, the more you earn. For investors, the token economics design of $MOONINI (90% for users, 10% for the team, 6-stage halving, lock-up releases) effectively reduces short-term dump risks and is conducive to long-term value stability.

highlights.title: Core highlights
items: ✅ **Fair distribution**: 90% of tokens are distributed through user activities, with 10% going to the team and early investors.
✅ **Early advantage**: 6-stage halving mechanism, the earlier you participate, the more you receive.
✅ **Reduce risk**: Team allocation is locked for 3 months, then linearly released over 33-45 months.
✅ **Transparent and verifiable**: All token distribution and release rules are publicly transparent and on-chain verifiable.

problems.title: Pain points in existing Web3 / Telegram marketing
items: **Difficult to track effectiveness**: Traditional Red Packet mechanisms are hard to trace for actual effects; it is unclear who claimed, who shared, or whether it brought in new users.
**Short-term profit-taking**: Many projects focus only on short-term traffic, distributing red packets and leaving without long-term incentive mechanisms.
**Lack of long-term incentives**: Users leave after claiming Red Packets, unable to establish long-term relationships and continuous participation.

solutions.title: The solution of moonpacket + $MOONINI
items: **Complete behaviour tracking**: moonpacket records the reception of each red packet, sharing behaviour, and new user introductions, allowing you to clearly understand marketing effectiveness.
**Long-term incentive mechanisms**: Through the $MOONINI token, the more users participate, the more they earn, establishing long-term participation motivation.
**Fair value distribution**: 90% of tokens go to users, ensuring community priority, while mechanisms like halving and lock-up reduce dump risks.

philosophy.title: Why is this design?
items: **User Prioritisation**: 90% of tokens are allocated to users to ensure that the community truly benefits, instead of being monopolised by a few individuals.
**Team Incentives**: 10% for the team and early investors to ensure the project has sufficient resources for continuous development, with a moderate proportion to avoid excessive concentration.
**No Pre-Reserved Presale/VC**: We do not reserve quotas for institutional investors, and all tokens are distributed to users through a fair mechanism.
**Risk Mitigation**: Team allocation is subject to lock-up and linear release mechanisms, effectively reducing the risk of short-term dumping and protecting investor interests.

halving.title: 6 Phase Halving Mechanism
halving.description: To encourage early participants, token distribution employs a 'progressive halving' mechanism. The earlier you join, the more tokens you can earn:
halving.example: For example: In Phase 1, if you send a 100 USDT Red Packet, you can earn 100 $MOONINI; in Phase 2, sending the same 100 USDT Red Packet would only earn you 50 $MOONINI. The earlier you participate, the greater your advantage!

vesting.title: Team Quota Lock-up and Release
vesting.description: In a market filled with 'mouse warehouses' and 'hidden chips,' we chose the most difficult yet honest path. We deeply understand that only by completely eliminating users' fear of 'team selling' can we establish true trust.
items: **Total Transparency, No Hiding**: We have no hidden wallets or undisclosed early circulating supply. All token distributions are publicly available on-chain, subject to community oversight.

**Team Self-Restraint, Long-term Commitment**: The release period for the core team lasts **48 months (4 years)**. In the crypto space, four years is a long cycle. This proves we are not here to make quick money but are committed to experiencing bull and bear markets alongside the community to build long-term value.

**Investor Consensus**: Our early investors deeply resonate with the 'sharing and gifting' culture of Red Packets and voluntarily signed a **36-month** linear release agreement. This means in the early stages of the project, no party (including investors) has enough tokens to impact the market.
vesting.benefit: This is not just a lock-in rule but our **'Anti-Harvest Declaration'**. Through this almost rigorous self-restraint, we ensure that no one—whether founders or large holders—can betray the community in the early stages. We stand with all Red Packet senders to jointly maintain the purity of this social value.

why.title: Why do this?
items: **Reduce short-term dumps**: Lockup and linear release mechanisms prevent the team and investors from selling off large amounts early in the project.
**Extend project lifespan**: Gradual release ensures the project has enough time to develop and establish value.
**Protect investors**: Halving mechanisms and lockup designs provide more protection for early holders.

how_to_earn.title: How to earn £moonini?
methods: **Send Red Packet**: For every **equivalent of 1 USDT** sent as a Red Packet (supporting multiple currencies), participants receive corresponding $MOONINI based on the current stage.

**Complete Tasks**: Includes one-off achievement tasks and social tasks. To ensure fairness, each account is allowed to complete each task only once or set with a total limit to avoid malicious coin farming.

**Invite Friends**: Invite new friends and complete sharing tasks, both parties receive rewards. **Each account has a limit on invitation rewards**, and specific rules are subject to community announcements.
**Collaborating Applications**: Completing specific actions in games or applications integrated with the moonpacket API can also earn £moonini.

how_to_use.title: Uses of $MOONINI

**Unlock Features**: Certain premium features may require holding a certain amount of £moonini to use.
**Governance Voting Rights**: Holding $MOONINI allows participation in future community governance votes, influencing the project's development direction.
**Ecosystem Redemption**: Can be redeemed for special benefits or rewards in partner applications or games.

contracts.title: Contract Address
contracts.description: To ensure transparency, all core smart contract addresses will be publicly disclosed and verified.

principles.title: Governance principles
principles.description: Our core principle is: **there is no single highest authority**, all important operations require multiple confirmations and delayed publication to ensure transparency and security.

market_making.title: Real market declaration
description: **Reject false transactions**: We commit to not using wash trading or creating fake depth. Every transaction on the K-line comes from real users.
**Decentralised market making**: Liquidity is entirely determined by market supply and demand as well as the protocol's automated repurchase mechanism, rather than human manipulation.

floor_defense.title: Smart floor price defence
floor_defense.mechanism: **Mechanism**: When the coin price hits the floor area, the accumulated protocol fees will automatically buy back and destroy/inject liquidity.
floor_defense.anti_gaming: **Anti-sniping strategy**: To avoid bots predicting arbitrage, specific 'entry timing' and 'single transaction amount' contain random variables and will not be completely public. However, the core logic remains: **transaction fees will ultimately return to the pool to support the price**.
floor_defense.variance: Note: Due to market volatility, the floor price is not an absolute anchor but a dynamic support range.

process.title: Governance process
steps: **Delayed confirmation**: All high-risk operations must undergo a 48-hour delay confirmation period, during which they are visible on-chain.
**Execution**: After the delay period, authorised personnel will execute or it will be executed automatically.
**Cancellation**: During the delay period, the proposer can cancel the proposal.

security.title: Security measures
items: **Multi-signature confirmation**: All important operations require signatures from at least 2 people to avoid a single point of risk.
**Delayed execution mechanism**: High-risk operations must undergo a 48-hour delay, giving the community enough time to review and respond.
**Standard contract library**: Use audited standard contract libraries to reduce vulnerability risks.
**Third-party audits**: Smart contracts will undergo third-party security audits to ensure safety.
**Open-source transparency**: Contract code is open-source, anyone can verify and audit it.

risk_mitigation.title: How can we reduce single point risk?
risk_mitigation.description: We ensure that no single person or organisation can fully control the project through multi-signature, delayed confirmation, audits, and open-source multi-layer protection mechanisms. All important decisions go through a transparent and traceable process, providing reassurance to the community and investors.

items.question: How to earn tokens?
items.answer: You can earn $MOONINI by sending Red Packets, completing tasks, inviting friends, etc. The more Red Packets you send and tasks you complete, the more tokens you will earn. Early participants can enjoy a higher reward ratio.

items.question: When can withdrawals be made?
items.answer: Once the mainnet is launched, users can withdraw $MOONINI to their wallets. Withdrawals require a small Gas fee (BSC network fee), please pay attention to the official announcement for the exact launch time.

items.question: Is there a lock-up period for team allocations?
items.answer: Yes. The team allocation (10%) will be locked for 3 months, after which it will be released linearly over 33-45 months. The operating, technical team, and PR/marketing allocations will last a total of 48 months, while early investor allocations will last a total of 36 months.

items.question: Why adopt the halving mechanism?
items.answer: The halving mechanism is designed to encourage early participants while controlling the speed of token distribution. The earlier you participate, the more tokens you earn, which helps attract early users and investors while avoiding excessive issuance later leading to inflation.

items.question: What should be done if there are issues with the contract or system?
items.answer: We will mitigate risks through third-party security audits, multi-signature confirmations, delayed execution, and other multi-layer protection mechanisms. If issues do occur, we will immediately initiate emergency procedures, decide on a solution through governance, and promptly announce to the community.

items.question: What is the total amount of $MOONINI? Will it be increased?
items.answer: The total supply of $MOONINI is 10,000,000,000 tokens (10B), a fixed total that will never be increased. 90% will be gradually released through user activities, and 10% will be allocated to the team and early investors.

items.question: How to participate in governance?
items.answer: Users holding $MOONINI can participate in future community governance votes, impacting the development direction of the project. Specific governance mechanisms and voting methods will be gradually introduced after the mainnet launch.

items.question: Can $MOONINI be traded?
items.answer: Once the mainnet is launched and liquidity pools are established, $MOONINI can be traded on decentralised exchanges (such as PancakeSwap). Trading will be influenced by market supply and demand, and prices may fluctuate, so please invest cautiously.

meta.title: moonpacket Authentication API
meta.subtitle: Standard Interface for Querying Reward Rules and User Status (v2.3)
meta.description: Simply provide a GET Endpoint for moonpacket to query your rules and user status, easily integrating Red Packet and task systems.

hero.title: Authentication API
hero.subtitle: Attribute Query Interface (GET)
hero.desc: Through a standardised GET query interface, moonpacket actively retrieves 'reward rules' and 'user attributes' from your server. All logical judgements are handled by moonpacket.

overview.title: Access Configuration
desc: When selecting 'Custom API' in moonpacket’s 'Claim Conditions Setting', please provide your Endpoint URL.
**Authentication**: Authentication information will be fully transmitted via Header (`X-API-KEY` and `Signature`), and the URL will not contain sensitive information.

logic.title: Interaction Logic
logic.desc: The entire process is divided into two phases: 'Setup Phase' and 'Runtime Phase'. moonpacket will send requests to your API using the GET method:

modes.title: Phase one: Define rules (Configuration)
modes.trigger: Trigger timing: when entering the URL in the 'Claim Conditions Settings' and submitting it
modes.response: Returns a rule definition object with operators (gt, eq, lt...)

modes.title: Phase Two: Validate User (Runtime)
modes.trigger: Trigger Timing: User attempts to claim the Red Packet
modes.response: Return the actual attribute values of this specific user (pure numbers or strings)

logic.note: Supported Operators: `eq` (equals, supports strings/numbers), `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal to), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal to). Values for non-`eq` operators must be numbers.

request.title: Request Parameters (Query Params)
query: **api_key** (required): The API Key you set up for identification
**user_id** (optional): Returns user attributes when present; returns rule definitions when absent

ts_def.title: Data Structure Definition (TypeScript)
ts_def.desc: The following interface defines the JSON structure that must be returned for AI-assisted tools to read:

items.title: GameFi Integration
items.desc: Define the rule `level >= 10`. When the user claims, moonpacket checks the user's attributes; if `level: 12` then it is approved.

items.title: Identity Binding Reward
items.desc: Define the rule `kyc == true`. moonpacket checks the user status, and if it returns `kyc: true`, then rewards are distributed.

items.title: Blacklist Filtering
items.desc: Define rule `is_blacklist == false`. If the API returns `is_blacklist: true`, the claim will be rejected.

mode_a.title: 1. Define Rules (Setup)
mode_a.desc: When submitting settings, return JSON containing operators.

mode_b.title: 2. Query Status (Runtime)
mode_b.desc: When the user claims, return pure values or strings.

signature.title: Security Validation
signature.desc: To ensure the authenticity of requests, moonpacket will include a signature in the header. You can refer to the code on the right for validation:
steps: 1. Extract Timestamp, Nonce, Signature from Headers
2. Verify if the Timestamp is within a reasonable time range (e.g., ±5 minutes)
5. Compare the calculated result with the Signature in the Header

reliability.title: Note
items: **Timeout**: Ensure the API can return results within **3 seconds**.
**Format**: Please strictly adhere to JSON structure; otherwise, it will lead to parsing failure.

items.desc: Request parameters are incorrect (e.g. incorrect format).
Authorization Header is missing or Key is invalid.
IP restrictions or no permission to access this resource.
User ID does not exist (for querying user status scenarios).

allocation.title: 2.2 Allocation Plan
description: **Total Supply: 10,000,000,000 tokens (10B)**
**Allocation Principles**:
- **90% to Community & Liquidity**:

- Includes the "mining portion" generated through Red Packets and tasks, as well as the "liquidity portion" used to establish initial trading pairs (the project team initially inputs 10,000 USDT as the pool to ensure value at launch).
- This portion is fully returned to ecosystem participants, with none reserved for institutions or private placements.
- **10% to Team & Early Supporters**:
- **4% Early Investors**: Rewards for early financial support.
- **2% Technical Team**: Ensures ongoing development and maintenance of the protocol.
- **2% Operation Team**: Responsible for community management and event planning.
- **2% Marketing and Ecosystem Stability**: Promote market growth and maintain ecosystem stability during extreme conditions as a reserve fund.
**Governance Pledge**:

We implement the strictest internal fund control. All team allocations and operational expenses are subject to **Multisig** and **Timelock** restrictions. No single person can freely access funds, ensuring that every expenditure is made through collective decision-making and is publicly transparent.

phase.title: 2.3 6-Phase Halving Mechanism
description: To encourage early participants, the token distribution adopts a 'progressive halving' mechanism:
| Phase | Issued Amount Range | Redemption Ratio (per 1 USDT) | Description |
| **Phase 1** | 0 ~ 4.5B | **1.0 token** | Early participants, 1:1 exchange |
| **Phase 2** | 4.5B ~ 6.75B | **0.5 token** | Halved |
| **Phase 3** | 6.75B ~ 7.875B | **0.25 token** | Halved again |
| **Phase 4** | 7.875B ~ 8.4375B | **0.125 token** | Continuing halving |
| **Phase 5** | 8.4375B ~ 8.71875B | **0.0625 token** | Nearing the end |
| **Phase 6** | 8.71875B ~ 9B | **0.03125 token** | Final phase |
**Example**:
- In Phase 1, if you send a 100 USDT Red Packet, you can receive 100 $MOONINI
- In Phase 2, if you send a 100 USDT Red Packet, you can only receive 50 $MOONINI
- The earlier you participate, the more tokens you receive!
value_logic: 💡 Red Packet Philosophy and Value Cycle
**The spirit of the Red Packet is 'Giving' and 'Connection'**:

Originating from Eastern culture, the Red Packet represents not only the transfer of funds but also the love from elders to juniors, congratulations, and sharing among friends. At moonpacket, each time you send a Red Packet is a warm social interaction.

We believe that these acts of goodwill should be recorded and valued. $MOONINI is not just a reward token; it is the value carrier of this social network, generating long-tail economic effects from every 'giving'.
To maintain the stability of this social value, the protocol specifies: **50% of transaction fee revenue will automatically be injected into the Liquidity Pool**.

This means: the more active the community ➔ the more Red Packet interactions ➔ the more funds injected into the liquidity pool ➔ the more solid the value foundation of $MOONINI. This is a positive cycle based on real social needs and business revenue, rather than purely speculative gambling.

contracts.title: 3.2 Smart Contract Architecture
description: We use industry-verified smart contract standards to ensure the security and reliability of the tokens.
**Core Design Principles**:
- **Decentralised**: All token issuance and release mechanisms are executed automatically via smart contracts, requiring no human intervention.
- **Transparent and Traceable**: All operational records are stored on the blockchain, accessible by anyone.
- **Secure and Reliable**: Utilising a third-party audited standard contract library to ensure code quality and security.
**Main Functions**:
- **Token Issuance**: Token issuing and transferring in compliance with BSC standards.
- **Automatic Release**: Manage the gradual release (6 phases of halving) of 90% of publicly issued tokens.
- **Team Lock-up**: Management of 10% team allocation for lock-up and linear release
- **Governance Mechanism**: All important operations require multi-signature confirmation, with a 48-hour cooling-off period to allow the community time to review
- **Automatic Buyback**: Platform fees are automatically used to buy back tokens, enhancing liquidity
**Security Measures**:
- Utilises a third-party audited standard contract library to ensure code quality and security
- All important operations require multi-signature confirmation, with a 48-hour cooling-off period to allow the community time to review
- Advanced authentication technology used during user withdrawals to ensure only the user can operate
- Employs a replay attack prevention mechanism to protect user funds
- Plan to undergo third-party security audits (CertiK / PeckShield / SlowMist)
*For detailed technical specifications, contract interfaces, and function definitions, please refer to: [Technical Specification Document](/en-GB/docs/technical)*

- Specific amounts will be announced before the mainnet launch
launch_protection: - **Single Purchase Limit**: 30 minutes before opening, a single wallet can buy only 0.5% or 1% of the total amount
- **Protect Small Retail Investors**: Prevent large holders from taking all liquidity when the market opens
- **Time Window**: Automatically lifted after 30 minutes, not affecting normal trading
- **Maintain Price Stability**: Avoid sharp price fluctuations at opening
release_methods: **Release Method**: Gradual release through user activities
1. **Send Red Packets**: Each time 1 USDT Red Packet is sent, receive corresponding £moonini based on the current phase
2. **Invite Friends**: Successfully invite new users and complete sharing tasks to receive £moonini
3. **Complete Tasks**: Complete achievement tasks, social tasks, etc., to earn extra £moonini
4. **Group Owner Profit Sharing**: Group owners can receive 3% profit share (USDT) for sending Red Packets across groups
cost_vs_price: In Phase 1, the implicit cost of obtaining 1 $MOONINI through Red Packet mining is approximately **0.02 USDT** (based on 2% transaction fee).
While our initial listing price is **0.01 USDT**.
This means that **the secondary market purchase cost is 50% lower than production cost**, providing early holders with a natural safety margin.
withdraw_mechanism: - After users earn $MOONINI on the platform, they can withdraw it to their wallet through a secure identity verification mechanism
- The system will verify based on user activity records to ensure that only the user can operate.
- Once verified, users can withdraw their tokens to their wallet.
- **Transaction Fee**: Users only need to pay the network transaction fee (in line with blockchain practices)
*For detailed technical implementation, please refer to: [Technical Specification Document](/en-GB/docs/technical)*
phase_switch: - Automatically switch to the next phase when the issued amount reaches the phase threshold
- The switching process is transparent and traceable, recorded on-chain

team.title: 4.2 Team Quota (10%)
vesting_rules: | Category | Proportion | Lock-up Period (Cliff) | Linear Release Period | Total Duration |
- **Linear Accumulation**: Tokens accumulate linearly over time, and the amount available for withdrawal can be checked at any time.
- **Regular Releases**: Automatic regular triggers for release without the need for manual operation.
- **Notification Mechanism**: Automatic notifications sent to beneficiaries after each release is completed.
- First 3 months: Lock-up period, no withdrawals permitted
- Starting from the 4th month: Tokens accumulate linearly over time, with regular withdrawals of the accumulated portion.

kyc.title: 4.3 Investor KYC and Management
methods: **KYC Method** (for a limited number of initial investors):
1. **Founding Team Real-Name KYC** (Recommended, suitable for small scale)
- Suitable for a smaller initial number of investors (< 10 people)
- Founding team members (Operations + Technical) conduct video interviews with investors
- Verify identity documents, proof of address, and other materials
- Confirm via PDF electronic signature (DocuSign/SignNow)
- **Advantages**: Low cost, flexible process, builds trust
2. **Shufti Pro** (Suitable for medium scale)
- Suitable for a moderate number of investors (10-50 people)
- 10 free verification slots per month (suitable for initial use)
- Automated process, supports multi-country document verification.
- **Advantages**: Automation, high compliance, supports multi-country documentation.
3. **Other Third-Party KYC** (Future Expansion)
- Persona / Sumsub / Onfido as alternatives
- Suitable for a larger number of investors (> 50 people)
flexibility: **Investor Flexible Design**:
**Support for Multiple Wallets and Different Ratios**:
- An investor can have multiple wallets to receive tokens.
- Each wallet can set different allocation ratios (e.g., 60% / 40%).
- Different investors can have different entry times.
**Wallet Replacement Mechanism (Cancellation and Reissuance Strategy)**:
- Investors can change their receiving wallet (requires re-KYC verification).
- **Core Logic**: Rather than directly modifying the old wallet, revoke the old release plan and create a new release plan for the new wallet.
- **Process**:
1. Investors report the loss/theft of their old wallets and complete off-chain KYC verification.
2. Through a multi-signature wallet proposal, revoke the old release plan and return unissued tokens.
3. Create a new release plan for the new wallet, with the amount being the remaining portion and the time being the remaining duration.
4. All operations have a 48-hour delay confirmation to ensure transparency and security.
- **Advantages**: Contract logic is simpler (only create and revoke), significantly reducing the risk of hacking.
- Only affects the 'unreleased' portion; released tokens cannot be reversed.

mechanism.title: 5.1 Governance Mechanism
core_principle: **Core Principle**: **No single highest authority**, all important operations must undergo delayed public review
1. **Proposal**: Governance proposal established after multi-signature wallet approval
2. **Review Period**: Enter 48-hour delay queue, all actions publicly visible on the blockchain
3. **Execution**: Proposals can be executed after the delay expires
4. **Cancellation**: During the review period, the proposer can cancel the proposal
- Parameter adjustments (transaction fees, buy-back limits, etc.)
- Treasury allocations (next phase quotas, event budgets, etc.)

security.title: 5.2 Security Measures
description: **Multi-layer Protection**:
1. **Multi-signature Wallet**: All important operations require at least 2 signatures for confirmation
2. **Delayed Execution**: All high-risk operations require a 48-hour delay
3. **Audit**: Through third-party security audits
4. **Open Source**: The contract code is open source and can be publicly verified.
**Permission Management**:
- **Token Issuance Authority**: Revoked or transferred to the governance treasury, cannot issue tokens at will.
- **Freezing Authority**: Closed, cannot freeze user tokens.
- **Updating Authority**: Only the governance address can modify token information.

pol.title: 5.3 Buyback and Market Making (POL - Unlimited Buyback + Floor Price Defence)
mechanism: - **1%** of platform transaction fees used to buy back $MOONINI and deepen the liquidity pool
- **Unlimited Buyback**: No daily limit on buybacks; as many transaction fees as there are, buybacks continue to provide liquidity support for the token
- **Automated Strategy**: Using smart buyback strategies to reduce predictability and avoid market manipulation
- **Buy Protection**: Automatically increases buyback efforts when there is a significant market drop, protecting investor interests
floor_defense: - **Automatic Defence**: When the price drops below the defence threshold, defence mode is triggered automatically, increasing buyback efforts
- **Automated Market Making**: Automatic market making based on smart contracts, requiring no manual intervention, ensuring market stability.
- **Save on Market Maker Fees**: Use the budget for issuing Red Packets, marketing, or increasing initial liquidity
philosophy: - Low entry barriers, high game-theoretic returns
- Project party does not interfere with the market (only provides transaction fee buybacks)
- Automatically maintains the psychological price level to uphold market confidence
*For detailed technical parameters and implementation strategies, please refer to: [Technical Specification Document](/en-GB/docs/technical)*

how_to_earn.title: 6.1 How to Obtain $MOONINI?
send_gift: - **Basic Rules**: For every sent **equivalent of 1 USDT** Red Packet (supports multiple tokens), the system will calculate and distribute $MOONINI based on the current phase exchange rate.
- **Conveying Blessings**: Red packets are not just money; they are a conveyance of blessings. Each act of gifting will be recorded on the blockchain and rewarded.
invite: - **Rules**: Invite new friends and complete sharing tasks, both parties receive rewards.
- **Anti-Spam Mechanism**: To ensure fairness, **each account has an invitation reward limit**, which will be dynamically adjusted according to the latest community game design announcement.
- **Risk Control**: We have strict risk control mechanisms; any abnormal spamming behaviour will be deemed invalid.
quests: - Includes one-time achievement tasks (such as sending the first Red Packet) and social tasks (such as following the official community).
- These tasks are designed to familiarise newcomers with platform features, **each account can only complete once or has a total quantity limit**.
- To prevent script automation from spamming coins, leaving rewards for genuine active users.

api.title: 7.2 Integration Modes and API (In Planning)
intro: moonpacket plans to provide a complete API ecosystem, enabling third-party developers and partners to easily integrate the $MOONINI reward mechanism into their products. Whether it's a Telegram bot, Web3 game, or marketing campaign platform, our API allows users to receive $MOONINI rewards, expanding ecological influence.
types: We plan to provide the following types of APIs to meet various integration needs:
- **Data Reading API**: Query Red Packet distribution records, task completion status, user $MOONINI balance, and more, allowing partners to understand user activity status.

- **Distribution and Task API**: Allows partners to trigger Red Packet distributions or task rewards in their own products, for example, automatically distributing $MOONINI rewards when users achieve specific milestones in a game.

- **Webhook Events**: The system proactively notifies partners of important events such as when users complete tasks, claim Red Packets, or finalize withdrawals, enabling real-time responses and data synchronisation.
security: To ensure the security and stability of the API, we implement the following mechanisms:
- **API Key Authentication**: Each partner will receive a dedicated API Key or application ID for identification and authorisation.
- **Rate Limiting**: All API requests are rate limited to prevent abuse and overloading, ensuring service stability.
- **Signature Verification**: Critical operations (e.g., issuing rewards) require request signature verification to prevent forgery and unauthorised actions.
- **Permission Levels**: Different partners will have different API permission levels based on their collaboration relationship and needs, ensuring the principle of least privilege.
release: The API will adopt a progressive opening strategy to ensure stability and security:
- **Closed Beta**: Initially provided to partners and early game developers in a closed beta format to collect feedback and optimise experiences.
- **Gradual Opening**: After verifying stability during the Beta phase, applications will gradually open to allow more developers to integrate the $MOONINI ecosystem.
- **Formal Release**: Once the API reaches production-level stability, it will be officially open to the public, providing complete documentation and support.

scenarios.title: Typical Integration Scenarios
items: **Telegram Bot / Mini App**: Send Red Packets in your groups or applications to allow users to receive £moonini rewards, increasing user engagement.
**Web3 Games**: Report task completion status in games to moonpacket, allowing players to automatically receive additional £moonini rewards upon completing game tasks.
**Marketing Campaign Platforms**: Automatically send £moonini rewards based on user behaviour on social media (e.g., sharing, retweeting, following, etc.), achieving precise marketing.
**DeFi Protocols**: Integrate $MOONINI as an additional reward layer, allowing users to earn $MOONINI rewards on top of original profits for completing specific DeFi actions.
**Content Creation Platforms**: Automatically issue £moonini rewards when creators complete specific tasks or reach milestones, encouraging quality content creation.

tools.title: 7.3 Developer Tools and Documentation
description: To help developers integrate the moonpacket API more easily, we plan to provide complete developer tools and documentation:
- **Developer Portal**: Provides a unified entry point for developers, including API key management, usage statistics, error logs, and more, allowing developers to easily manage their integrations.
- **API Documentation**: Provides complete REST API and Webhook documentation, including request samples, response formats, error code explanations, etc., enabling developers to get started quickly.
- **SDK and Code Samples**: Provides SDKs in multiple languages (such as JavaScript, Python) and code samples to lower integration barriers, allowing developers to implement quickly.

Currently, technical documents are presented from the document centre (docs) technical page, including smart contract specifications, distribution mechanisms, task systems, and other technical details. Complete API documentation will be organised on the 《[Developer API Documentation](/en-GB/docs/api/)》 page, and official API documentation and developer tools will be gradually released around the mainnet launch, so please stay tuned.
